tooltip.nameless_trinkets.moon_stone_1: Gentler low gravity: 3/8 of its former strength.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.missing_page_1: Enemy hits release a 5-block burst. Triggers once every 4s.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.missing_page_2: Deals 1 damage +10% of your strongest offensive power, up to 6 per target.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.eclipse_ashes_: Enemy hits summon phantom wolves for 5s. Each deals 1 damage +5% offensive power, up to 3. 12s interval.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.resonant_heart: Enemy hits have a 10% chance to release a sonic burst: 2 damage +15% offensive power, up to 8. 6s interval.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.reverse_card_1: 25% chance to reflect 25% of an enemy hit, capped at 2 +10% offensive power, up to 6. 4s interval.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.vampire_blood_: Enemy kills restore 2 HP +5% of your maximum HP, up to 4 HP. 2s interval.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.ghast_eye_1: +7.5% maximum HP, up to +6 HP. Does not heal on equip.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.titans_mark_2: +5% attack damage and +15% maximum HP, up to +10 HP. Resistance I and Slowness I while worn.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.woundbearer_1: Stored attack damage: +%1$s. Holds up to 10% of your melee power, capped at +4. Decays after 3s.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.sigil_of_bapho: Further kills add 0.5s to the remaining immunity.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.creeper_sense_: Sneaking triggers a power-3 explosion every 12s.
Does not destroy blocks. The blast can still hurt you.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.four_leaf_clov: Enemy kills have a 25% chance to roll their loot once more.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.explosion_proo: Qualifying explosions grant 1 TNT, at most once every 20s.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.rage_mind_2: Deal +10% damage to the marked creature type.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.fate_emerald_1: Improves villager prices with a modest trade discount.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.tick_1: Drains eligible enemies within 8 blocks once per second for 1 damage +10% offensive power, up to 6.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.tick_2: Each successful pulse costs 5% of your maximum HP, or hunger when below 5 HP.
tooltip.nameless_trinkets.tick_3: Only affects non-player enemies above half health with more than 50 maximum HP.
